selection_rule: Use 192 unless measured validation extrapolation exceeds 48 inference hours on the existing GPU; then use 96. This is an operational planning heuristic, not a user billing limit. Never stop a frozen run because of significance or an effect direction.
secondary_validation_rule: Report secondary workflow competence separately; a decline limits secondary interpretation and does not invalidate a qualified primary scheduling population.
precision_rule: Export stratified prospective half-width approximations at both sizes. Do not invent power or claim adequate precision from zero observed variation. If the resource-limited size is imprecise, retain that limitation.
supporting_sampling_note: One consequential and one preserving base per family. Preserving cases include regular, tie and NONE structures. Change-class strata pool families in this small exploratory subset; no family-specific inferential claims.
dose_response: Omitted exploratory extension to preserve the core paired design and reduce GPU use.
